photosynthesis. When temperature exceeds 3o'C, the rate of photosynthesis
lowers down. Similarly, at low temperature the rate declines and at freezing

Respiration
Respiration is defined as oxidation-reduction processes which occur inside the
living cells during which organic food is broken down into carbon dioxideandwater
and energyis released.Glucose is themost commonfood used in this process.The
purpose of respiration is to release energyfor the living processes.Respiration is
commonto all living organisms because all of themneed energyforlife activities.
